note: Acceptance contract for the web app. Every figure hash below was captured from the DESKTOP app (QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen, SimpleWindow, savefig dpi=200 facecolor) with the same inputs and the same sidebar checkboxes, with no VAMPIRE run loaded; the web path must produce identical PNG bytes. The web default is figure_default (light theme + Savitzky-Golay smoothing on); the desktop starts light too (app.py) but with smoothing off. Rate numbers are cross-checked against ../baselines/golden.json at test time.

bundled_runs_note: rate_100Kns ships 25 of the 26 completed seeds in the source folder, so all three bundled runs use the same seed_1..seed_25 ensemble; seed_26 (100 K/ns only) is deliberately left out.
